snippet.title: The Unbreakable Gumball - Concept Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The Unbreakable Gumball is an open-world superhero game that takes place inside of a comic book! Jump, swing, and glide around the city of the future! 

Supports both standard play and virtual reality.

Demo available now on Steam and itch.io!

Download:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/833870/The_Unbreakable_Gumball/

https://maxalo.itch.io/gumball
